calls.statement:
WITH web_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(f.gross_amount) AS gross_sales_incl_vat
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN fact_web_order w ON f.receipt_id = w.web_order_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
  WHERE s.store_id = 900
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
  ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
)
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, gross_sales_incl_vat FROM web_sales;

-- Verify web sales calculation by showing net and gross separately
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS order_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_ex_vat,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) AS gross_sales_incl_vat,
  ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount) - SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS vat_amount
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN fact_web_order w ON f.receipt_id = w.web_order_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
WHERE s.store_id = 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period;

-- Check web returns for the same period
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) AS return_count,
  SUM(r.refund_net) AS total_refund_net,
  SUM(r.refund_gross) AS total_refund_gross
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
WHERE s.store_id = 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period;
